description: Deliver the saved scientific account. Completing its organization does not resolve the scientific questions it explicitly retains. status states that scientific state; disposition separately states technical write delivery.

disposition.description: Write delivery status, not scientific completeness: COMPLETE when no rejected write is left unresolved. Choose disposition PARTIAL to stop with unresolved writes; the host records them in the delivery without marking them repaired.

explanation.description: Brief reason for the chosen scientific status, pointing to unresolved matters if any. The saved records carry the complete scientific account; do not restate their experimental procedures or add new scientific conclusions here.

status.description: Scientific state of the account, not whether writing is finished. Use PARTIAL when the account explicitly retains an unresolved scientific question or unresolved alternatives, even if all supplied meaning has been organized. Use COMPLETE when no such unresolved scientific question remains within this task. Missing database fields or facts outside the task do not determine this status. Both statuses can be delivered successfully; disposition separately states technical write delivery.
